changelog:
Sleep Quality Coach 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Launches a comprehensive 10-step evidence-based sleep improvement workflow, powered by CBT-I and chronotype assessment.
- Collects a detailed sleep profile in 3-5 dialogue turns, covering habits, environment, and daytime functioning.
- Provides objective sleep quality assessment (PSQI score, chronotype, sleep efficiency, total sleep time, sleep debt).
- Identifies core sleep problem type and severity, including mixed cases and red flags.
- Delivers a tailored improvement plan using targeted CBT-I techniques and behavioral adjustments.
- Includes 30- or 60-minute bedtime rituals, daytime guidance, special protocols for shift work/jet lag, and a 7-day progressive action plan.
summary: Personalized sleep coach using CBT-I and chronotype data to assess and improve sleep quality with tailored 7-day plans and behavior guidance.
